entries.title: The MATLAB version check reads the first product listed by ver
entries.why: Lines 137-141 take str2double of every ver entry and test matlabVersion(1) >= 24.2, assuming MATLAB is listed first; any other first product (e.g. a toolbox sorting before 'MATLAB') disables the Firth branch that the comment of lines 132-133 says should run from R2024b.

entries.title: The units line is dropped instead of being stored in VariableUnits
entries.why: Lines 52-55 only delete row 1 when it starts with unit(s); nothing ever sets Properties.VariableUnits, contradicting DESCRIPTION lines 7-8 and OUTPUTS lines 19-20.

entries.title: All warnings are switched on after the call
entries.why: Lines 39 and 43 call warning('off') / warning('on') instead of saving and restoring the caller's state; side effect only, the table is unaffected.

entries.title: The processed and mapped summary sheets hold the original data
entries.why: Lines 473-475 and 478-480 write taxonSummary.originalData / brayCurtis.originalData to the sheets processedData and mappedData, although mapTaxaCalcMetrics fills .processed and .mapped (lines 752-754).

entries.title: A comparison skipped for missing values gets p-value 0 and FDR 0
entries.why: In the skip branch (lines 160-163) p = nan is only a local; resultTable.("p-value")(i) keeps the 0 of the preallocated table (line 122), so FDR (line 203) is 0 and the row sorts first (line 206).

entries.title: The predictor name is accepted in any case but used as given
entries.why: Line 78 switches on lower(predictor) and line 96 names the column 'Flux', but line 134 reads dataGroup.(predictor); the header documents only 'Flux' / 'relative_abundance', so lower-case is undocumented input.

entries.title: 'unique_epsilon' stops with an error when no reaction changes
entries.why: With rxnFBS all zero, line 50 leaves an empty vector and line 51 indexes it with int64(0*0.7) = 0, an invalid index; a documented option on a documented (if degenerate) input.

entries.title: The documented codes of rxnFBS do not match the code
entries.why: Lines 15-16 say (+1;0;-1) for Forward/Backward/Unchanged, while lines 44, 50, 54, 57 treat 0 as unchanged.

entries.title: The documented default of alpha_values cannot be used
entries.why: alpha_values is a named argument (line 1) passed to parse on line 47, so omitting it raises Not enough input arguments; with -1, num_alphas = numel(-1) = 1 is computed on line 51 before line 53 expands alpha_values, so only one sheet is written.

entries.title: The sheets written with xlswrite need Microsoft Excel
entries.why: Lines 98-103, 116-117, 133-134 and 199 use xlswrite, which without Excel falls back to CSV (numeric only); the documented options RankingGeneID and differ_genes therefore misplace output or fail (SUMMARY, line 199) on every non-Windows platform, and the header states no Excel requirement, so by the rule a documented option fails when used (same platform reasoning as ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral's Linux defect). Does not change the quarantine.

entries.title: The parallel mode cannot start its worker processes on Linux and macOS
entries.why: Line 126 builds 'matlab ... -r ACHRSamplerParallelGeneral([],...,'<pwd>');exit; &' with the -r argument unquoted, which a POSIX shell rejects at '('; the master then loops forever on lines 285-296 waiting for xxRoundAck files only workers write.

entries.title: A log file is written into the current folder
entries.why: Line 115 fopen('ACHRParallelError.txt','w') in the current folder for every master call; closed on line 361 but never removed or documented.

entries.title: errorsA gives row numbers within the constraints of one sense, not rows of A
entries.why: Lines 56-58 call find on LHS(LIndex,:) etc., so row indices are relative to the subset of one sense, and line 63 stacks them without mapping back through find(LIndex); the help (lines 23-24) promises the row index in sampleStruct.

entries.title: One point stops with an error when a sense has a single row
entries.why: With one point and a satisfied single-row E sense, find at line 58 is applied to a 1x1 false and returns 1x0 outputs assigned into errorsE(:,1) of an undefined variable; whether MATLAB raises the subsassign dimension error there is a language-semantics question not settled by reading (running the trigger decides it). Note the title over-generalises: the single-row L sense in the same trigger is violated and works.

entries.title: sparse(i, j, s) pairs the values with the sorted pattern, not with (i, j)
entries.why: Line 133 builds a logical sparse pattern A (stored column-major, duplicates merged) while lines 135-136 store s(:) in input order; full (lines 145-150) writes s into find(A) order, so values are permuted relative to (i, j) and duplicates leave nnz(A) < numel(s).

entries.title: Every call stops because the parent script config does not exist
entries.why: Line 11 calls config, but no config.m exists anywhere in the repository (searched), so every call stops there and line 13 (addpath include) is never reached.

entries.title: sparse(i, j, s) pairs the values with the sorted pattern, not with (i, j)
entries.why: ddouble.m is CMatrix.m with the class name substituted (diff is empty after renaming); lines 133-136 pair the column-major logical pattern with input-order values exactly as in CMatrix.

entries.title: sparse(i, j, s) pairs the values with the sorted pattern, not with (i, j)
entries.why: qdouble.m lines 133-136 are identical to CMatrix's (column-major logical pattern, input-order values), so the same mis-pairing holds.

entries.title: minFlux and maxFlux cannot be requested together with a rounded polytope
entries.why: minFlux/maxFlux are assigned only inside 'if toPreprocess' (lines 119-120); with a roundedPolytope (toPreprocess = 0, line 72) the documented outputs of USAGE line 12 are unassigned, although the polytope carries .minFlux/.maxFlux (lines 35-36).

entries.title: A model without metabolites and a reaction of zero width stops in preprocess
entries.why: Line 105 replaces the empty 0 x n A_eq with [], so preprocess builds eq_constraints with size(P.A_eq,2) = 0 columns, grows it to 1 x 1 by logical indexing, and P.A*N fails at preprocess line 173; a zero-metabolite model is a degenerate input, so limitation is reasonable.

entries.title: minFlux and maxFlux cannot be requested together with a rounded polytope
entries.why: minFlux/maxFlux are assigned only at lines 154-155 inside 'if toPreprocess' (and never in the toRound == 3 branch, lines 79-108); with a roundedPolytope (lines 65-69) the documented outputs (lines 46-47) are unassigned. The entry's LINES (65-69) point at the switch, the missing assignments are 154-155.

entries.title: The documented default of nBins is never set, so a call without nBins fails
entries.why: Lines 17-20 assign the default to 'bins', and line 50 reads nBins, which is unset when nargin < 4.

entries.title: The fallback to the reversed reaction <name>_r never runs
entries.why: findRxnIDs returns 0 (ismember) for an absent name, so isempty at lines 40 and 55 is never true and line 46 indexes with 0. For a model that holds only <name>_r (an irreversible-split model), the call with <name> is the case lines 41 and 56-57 are written for; handling code that is never reached on that input is wrong-result by the rule. The given trigger ('r1_' with no 'r1__r') does not exercise that case. Does not change the quarantine.

entries.title: The chi-square p values are cumulative probabilities, near 0 for identical samples
entries.why: Line 75 returns cobraChi2cdf(stat, nBin-1), the lower tail, as the p value, and lines 70-73 build the statistic from relative frequencies (counts/nSample), so identical samples give p = 0 instead of 1.

entries.title: More points than pointsPerFile are taken from a file at regular intervals
entries.why: Line 50 sets pSkip = max(floor(numPoints/pointsPerFile),1) and line 51 takes 1:pSkip:numPoints, giving ceil(numPoints/pSkip) points (4 for 8/3, 8 for 8/5), not the documented pointsPerFile (line 11).

entries.title: With several samples only the first sample's mode is printed
entries.why: calcSampleStats stores mode as nRxns x nSamples; line 56 prints sampleStats.mode(i) (linear index, first sample) while lines 59-65 print (i,:), so with several samples the row has one value fewer than the header of lines 36-38 and later columns shift.

entries.title: The documented optional inputs cannot be omitted one at a time
entries.why: For nargin 4 or 5, line 53 reads dispRFlag (and line 71 fontSize) without an exist/nargin check, so Not enough input arguments; only nargin < 4 (lines 40-47) sets the defaults.

entries.title: The progress of the two-set layout exceeds 100 %
entries.why: Line 84 uses (i-1)*nRxns + j over nRxns*nRxns2; when nRxns > nRxns2 (two-set layout) the ratio exceeds 1.

entries.title: A model whose lower bounds are all zero stops with an error
entries.why: With no non-zero lb, minLB (line 219) and ratioL (line 222) are empty, and 'abs(minLB) > 0 && ...' at line 305 errors on an empty operand; same for ub at line 321. An all-irreversible model is valid.

entries.title: A model with C and d but without b stops with an error
entries.why: Lines 136 and 157 build [model.S, model.b; model.C, model.d] whenever C and d exist, without checking b, which the header (line 18) lists as an optional field analysed if present.

entries.title: r1norm and r2norm are not assigned when A'*b = 0
entries.why: Line 143 returns when arnorm = alfa*beta = 0, before r1norm/r2norm are set on lines 147-148 (and anorm etc. are set but var/cov not), so requesting the documented 4th output errors.

entries.title: The x = 0 message is printed even when show = 0
entries.why: Line 143 calls disp(msg(1,:)) unconditionally, ignoring show (documented line 33).

entries.title: The option scale = 0 always fails
entries.why: A and Cinv are assigned only inside 'if scale' (lines 72-90); with scale = 0, line 151 (lusol_obj(A')) and line 227 (nullS.Cinv = Cinv) reference undefined variables.

entries.title: q is wrong when A has a zero column
entries.why: Line 65 drops zero columns, so q from the reduced matrix indexes columns of A(:,~bool); lines 199-201 append ind(bool) without mapping q through find(~bool), giving repeated/missing indices and contradicting the q(1:rankA) contract of lines 26-27.

entries.title: Two pairs of classes are written to the same file, so one class of each pair is lost
entries.why: fileNameString is identical at lines 121/129 and 138/142, and both output loops open files with 'w' (lines 169, 233), so the later class overwrites the earlier one.

entries.title: The descriptions of the bydGt0LHS and bydGt0RHS classes state the wrong probability bound
entries.why: directionalityStats lines 165-167 define LHS as forwardProbability > 0.5+cutoff and RHS as < 0.5-cutoff, but lines 124 and 132 describe them as 'less than' the lower and 'greater than' the upper bound; the report states false bounds for the listed reactions (borderline with cosmetic, but entry 1 carries the quarantine).

entries.title: The printed Reverse -> Reverse count is the number of reverse -> reversible reactions
entries.why: Line 206 prints nnz(reverse2Reversible) under the label Reverse -> Reverse; nnz(reverse2Reverse) is never printed, so the report gives a false count.

entries.title: The reverse -> uncertain count is labelled Reversible -> Uncertain
entries.why: Line 209 prints nnz(reverse2Uncertain) with the label ' Reversible -> Uncertain'; the value is right, the label wrong.

entries.title: miliMolarStandard true stops with an error
entries.why: Lines 179-182 restore model.dGt0Min/Max from dGt0Min/dGt0Max, which are assigned only inside the disabled 'if horizontal' block (lines 186-197, horizontal = 0), so the true branch always errors.

entries.title: The structure array model.rxn is required but not documented
entries.why: Lines 163-169 read model.rxn(n).officialName and .equation, which the header (lines 11-28) does not list; documentation gap, non-quarantining.

entries.title: Reactions with a fixed DrGt0 stop the figures with an error
entries.why: P is never assigned in the file (the probability is held in forwardProbability, lines 84-93), yet lines 212, 230, 283, 327 and 381 use P in the fixed-DrGt0 figure branches.

entries.title: The warning about extra NaN probabilities is garbled
entries.why: Lines 140 and 638 call warning('A:B', text) so the text is a format and '\Delta' is an invalid escape; message only.

entries.title: A model without a qualifying transport reaction stops with an error
entries.why: With forwardTransportQuantReverseBool all false, minX (line 119) is empty and barh(...,'BaseValue',minX) at line 126 fails; textLen (line 183) would also be unassigned at line 185. A model with no such reaction is valid.

entries.title: The fields transportRxnBool and directions.forwardProbability are required but not documented
entries.why: Line 38 reads model.transportRxnBool and line 67 directions.forwardProbability, neither listed in lines 13-25; DrdGtMin is listed but only used in the dead branch (line 53).

entries.title: Every call fails when the error bars are adjusted
entries.why: Lines 49-50 (and 63-64) take get(errorbar,'Children') and index hE_c(2); modern ErrorBar objects have no such children (pre-R2014b handle-graphics code), so the call fails before the figure is finished.

entries.title: Only the first reaction is plotted for the documented n x 1 rxns
entries.why: Line 16 uses size(modelT.rxns,2), which is 1 for the documented n x 1 cell array (line 12), so the loop of lines 23-27 handles only reaction 1 (masked by entry 1).

entries.title: Every call fails on the undefined variable directions
entries.why: Line 34 reads directions.ChangeForwardReversibleBool_dGfGC, but directions is neither an input (line 1) nor assigned before.

entries.title: The metabolite argument metAbbr is never read
entries.why: metAbbr appears only in the signature and help (lines 1, 9, 20); the function body never uses it to select reactions.

entries.title: The documented figures option always fails in pie
entries.why: Line 50 passes labels {{'K_{eq}',..},{..},{..}}, a cell of cells, which pie rejects (labels must be char/cellstr), so figures ~= 0 always fails.

entries.title: The returned counts are offset by eps
entries.why: Lines 24-26 initialise nKeq, nGC, nNone to eps, so the documented counts (lines 16-18) are 1+eps etc. and eps instead of 0; integer comparisons by callers fail.

entries.title: No arrow for an irreversible exchange reaction that has a product
entries.why: For EX_/Exch_ reactions with lb >= 0 the branch of lines 51-56 prints ' <==> ' only when there is no product and nothing otherwise, so the written equation has no arrow.

entries.title: Non-integer stoichiometric coefficients are printed in exponent form
entries.why: Lines 41 and 62 use '%d', which MATLAB renders as %e for non-integers; value preserved, format only.

entries.title: Omitting the optional printLevel fails when a metabolite file is read
entries.why: printLevel is listed under OPTIONAL INPUTS (line 33) but has no default (only metBoundsFile/rxnBoundsFile, lines 45-50), so line 87 errors when a metabolite file is given without it.

entries.title: The concMax error message says Minimum
entries.why: Line 136 tests concMax but reports 'Minimum concentration bound is not finite'; message text only.

entries.title: The plot fails on an invalid line style, so no call returns
entries.why: Lines 173-174 set LineStyle to '.' and '*', which are markers, not line styles, so set errors on every call that reaches the figure.

entries.title: A model whose metabolites all have Keq data fails
entries.why: If every non-proton metabolite is Keq, the while loop of line 66 is skipped and measuredMetRxnRatio (assigned only on line 136) and priorityKeq are undefined at line 172 / the output.

entries.title: The identifier and the reconstruction formula are not tab separated
entries.why: Line 21 uses '%20s%20s\t%20s\n', so the first two fields are joined by space padding only (or not at all when both exceed 20 chars), contradicting the 'tab delimited file' of lines 2-3.

entries.title: The documented arguments gcmOutputFile, gcmMetList and jankowskiGroupData are ignored
entries.why: Lines 26-28 read model.jankowskiGroupData, model.gcmMetList and model.gcmOutputFile; the three documented arguments (lines 16-20) are never used.

entries.title: The documented call name createGroupIncidenceMatrix_old does not exist
entries.why: Line 1 and USAGE line 7 name the function createGroupIncidenceMatrix_old, but MATLAB resolves it by the file name; documentation only.

entries.title: A metabolite without group contribution data stops the call or is reported under another name
entries.why: Line 136 prints metAbbr, which is assigned only on line 138 in the other branch, so a NONE line before any data line errors and a later one prints the previous metabolite's identifier.

entries.title: The output file is named gc_data_webGCM.txt, not gc_data_webCGM.txt as documented
entries.why: Line 44 writes gc_data_webGCM.txt while OUTPUT (line 25) says gc_data_webCGM.txt; the data are written, and other code (dGfzeroGroupContToBiochemical.m line 104) refers to gc_data_webGCM.txt, so the documentation is what misnames the file. Does not change the quarantine.

entries.title: The method 'mol' stops with Too many input arguments
entries.why: Line 64 calls [inchi, molBool] = createInChIStruct(mets, [], molFileDir); only inchi/new/createInChIStruct.m has that signature, and initCobraToolbox (lines 811-819) removes the 'new' folders from the path, leaving inchi/old's two-input, one-output version. (In agent mode the removal is skipped, so the result there depends on path order.)

entries.title: Mol files are missed when another file precedes them or their name holds a dot or 'mol'
entries.why: Line 20 concatenates all dir names without separators, line 21 splits on the regex '.mol' (unescaped dot), line 22 strips dots; so a name following a non-.mol file is fused with it, 'xmol.mol' splits at 'xmol', and 'glc.D' becomes 'glcD', and those metabolites are skipped at line 36.

entries.title: Mol files are missed when another file precedes them or their name holds a dot or 'mol'
entries.why: Lines 18-20 build the mol list the same broken way (concatenation, unescaped '.mol' split, dot stripping), so existing mol files are not matched at line 34.

entries.title: Fewer than two cytoplasmic reactants with a spread distribution stop the call
entries.why: metInd is assigned only inside the selection at line 97 (line 89 test), so with none line 115 errors on metInd; with one, line 117 calls ylim([0.5 0.5]), which is not increasing. Both are valid models.

entries.title: The output lambda holds the ionic-strength curves, not the activity coefficients of the species
entries.why: Lines 34-43 fill lambda with the species coefficients, then line 65 reuses lambda(zi,x) for x = 1:1000, overwriting it, so the returned lambda is the 4 x 1000 curve matrix, not the documented species values (line 28).

entries.title: The standard transformed enthalpy dHf0 is always NaN
entries.why: Line 89 forces the non-mp branch ('|| 1'), line 195 sets dHzero = [] so the enthalpy branch is skipped and line 411 sets dHf0 = NaN; the documented optional input dHzero (line 25) is ignored and the documented output dHf0 (line 33) is always NaN.
